{{Short description|Open-source 3D-printed microscope}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=October 2026}}
The '''OpenFlexure Microscope''' is an [[open-source hardware|open-source]], [[3D printing|3D-printable]] [[microscope]] that includes a mechanical stage to move the sample and focus the optics.<ref>{{cite web |title=OpenFlexure Microscope README |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope/-/blob/master/README.md |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=The OpenFlexure Microscope is a 3D printable microscope, including a precise mechanical stage to move the sample and focus the optics.}}</ref> It is developed as part of research projects at several universities, with contributors in [[Glasgow]], [[Bath, Somerset|Bath]], [[Cambridge]] and [[Dar es Salaam]].<ref>{{cite web |title=OpenFlexure Microscope README |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope/-/blob/master/README.md |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=Most of the development of this design has been done as part of various research projects - if you would like to join our research groups in Glasgow or Bath [...] The team is bigger than Glasgow and Bath, there are contributors in Cambridge, Dar es Salaam, and beyond.}}</ref>

== Design ==
=== Hardware ===
The design gives very fine positioning of the sample and the lens. The developers describe it as enabling "very fine (sub-micron) mechanical positioning of the sample and the lens, with surprisingly good mechanical stability".<ref>{{cite web |title=OpenFlexure Microscope README |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope/-/blob/master/README.md |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=This project is a 3D printable design that enables very fine (sub-micron) mechanical positioning of the sample and the lens, with surprisingly good mechanical stability.}}</ref> The optics can vary widely, "ranging from a webcam lens to a 100x, oil immersion objective".<ref>{{cite web |title=OpenFlexure Microscope README |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope/-/blob/master/README.md |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=There are many different options for the optics, ranging from a webcam lens to a 100x, oil immersion objective.}}</ref>

The project presents the design as an answer to a known problem. Making a microscope from a [[webcam]] gives good results, but a good mechanical stage for focusing and moving the sample is hard to build.<ref>{{cite web |title=OpenFlexure Microscope README |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope/-/blob/master/README.md |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=The trick of making a microscope out of a webcam has been around for a little while, and produces good results. However, getting a nice mechanical stage to focus the microscope and move around on the sample is very difficult.}}</ref>

=== Software ===
The microscope is controlled by a separate software project, described by its developers as an "API server and web interface for the OpenFlexure Microscope".<ref>{{cite web |title=openflexure-microscope-server |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope-server |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=API server and web interface for the OpenFlexure Microscope.}}</ref>

== Licensing ==
The hardware design is released under the CERN Open Hardware Licence version 2, strongly reciprocal (CERN-OHL-S-2.0).<ref>{{cite web |title=OpenFlexure Microscope README |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope/-/blob/master/README.md |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=This project is open-source and is Released under the CERN Open Hardware License, strongly reciprocal, v2.0 or later (CERN-OHL-S-2.0)}}</ref> The server software is licensed under the [[GNU General Public License]] version 3.<ref>{{cite web |title=LICENSE |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope-server/-/blob/master/LICENSE |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3, 29 June 2007}}</ref>

The project does not sell microscopes itself, but several companies do.<ref>{{cite web |title=OpenFlexure Microscope README |url=https://gitlab.com/openflexure/openflexure-microscope/-/blob/master/README.md |website=GitLab |publisher=OpenFlexure |access-date=3 October 2026 |quote=The OpenFlexure Project doesn't sell micrscopes, but several companies do, you can find a [list on our website](https://openflexure.org/about/vendors).}}</ref>
